A '''copper hoe''' is a [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]] of the [[Copper equipment|copper]] tier, crafted from two [[copper ingot]]s and two sticks. It tills soil and breaks hoe blocks at speed 6.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Farming and mining ===
The copper hoe breaks hoe blocks at speed 6 (vanilla: 5) and has 350 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 2.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it can be melted down into a single copper ingot. It is also the base item for the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] and [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] upgrades at a [[smithing table]]. With a [[smithing upgrade template]], a copper hoe and alloy make a [[Shakudo Mattock|shakudo]] or [[hepatizon mattock]].
